structured_output.what_is_happening: IWYTS ("It Wants You To Stay") is a pump.fun bonding-curve coin, 24 minutes old, with a market cap of about $12.8k. It rose about 250% in its first 30 minutes on roughly $14k of volume from 72 unique buyers. Buying has now nearly stopped: GeckoTerminal shows 1 buyer and 4 sellers in the last 5 minutes, and price is down 5.5% over that window. The token was launched through UsePaid with the description "Fees to @aianddesign via UsePaid", which sends creator fees to a third-party X account. That account probably posted AI art or a video called "It Wants You To Stay"; I could not confirm this. The token links to a tweet from @ThomasKDunne, and GMGN shows that account was previously named BrianDelany. The deployer has launched 314 tokens and already closed its position. GMGN tags 44 bundler wallets, holding about 44% of top-trader share. A token with the same name launched about 27 days earlier (2HEH…pump) and now sits at about $3k market cap, so this is a relaunch of a name that has already faded.

narrative.description: Probably a meme based on an AI-art or creator post titled 'It Wants You To Stay', from @aianddesign or @ThomasKDunne. The creator-fee routing is a UsePaid 'tokenize a creator' launch. No wider cultural event found.
narrative.why_spreading: Early pump.fun trading, probably bundled plus serial-launcher flow. No organic discussion found by web search. The same name already pumped and faded about a month ago.

authenticity.evidence: The deployer has launched 314 tokens and has already closed its position (creator_close). GMGN tags 44 bundler wallets with a 44% top-bundler trader share, and the bot/degen rate is 44%. The linked X account was renamed (BrianDelany to ThomasKDunne). The launch is a fee-routing UsePaid token. The top 10 holders each hold an almost identical 2.2–2.7%, which is consistent with bundled buys. Web search found no organic mentions.
